_comment: Chapter 09: what each runbook step supports, and how its result is judged. controls are NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls at the system's baseline; other names OMB M-22-09 and CISA BOD 25-01 (SCuBA) policies where they apply; ksi names FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators, which are provider-side indicators: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself. The mapping of steps to requirements is the program's (Design guidance), built from the repository's verified mappings (Book 04, Chapter 10; Book 13, Appendix A; Book 12, Chapter 12; the Graph practice crosswalk). requiredFor lists the stages whose go/no-go needs a passing record of the step. check names how Add-PaEvidenceRecord judges a run folder.
